test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the cost price and value of profit of 6 articles L, M, N, O, P and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6d2021d76c3b038f20f6059c03ed2e581e67e600d6b39f9db55cd2ddedb32d1.png] 

Selling price = Cost price + Profit

A1 = The value of average selling price of all articles.

A2 = The value of average cost price of L, M, N and O.

What is the value of (A1 + A2)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The selling price of all articles

(1100 + 950 + 900 + 1100 + 750 + 1350) = 6150

A1 = Average = 6150/6 = 1025

A2 = The value of the average cost price of L, M, N and O

(800 + 700 + 500 + 600)/4 = 2600/4

⇒ 650

A1 + A2 = 1025 + 650 = 1675

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
